description: Na₂CaMnAl₂P₂H₂(O₅F₂)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to three O and four F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.82 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.46 Å. Ca is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form distorted CaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 60°. All Ca-O bond lengths are 2.39 Å. Both Ca-F bond lengths are 2.29 Å. Mn is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form MnO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 53°. There are two shorter (2.15 Å) and two longer (2.25 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. Both Mn-F bond lengths are 2.16 Å. There are two inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form AlO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-60°. There are two shorter (1.88 Å) and two longer (1.89 Å) Al-O bond lengths. Both Al-F bond lengths are 1.85 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to four O and two equivalent F atoms to form AlO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent AlO₄F₂ octahedra, and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 38-53°. There are two shorter (1.84 Å) and two longer (1.89 Å) Al-O bond lengths. Both Al-F bond lengths are 1.85 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent CaO₄F₂ octahedra, corners with two equivalent MnO₄F₂ octahedra, and corners with two AlO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-68°. There is one shorter (1.53 Å) and three longer (1.54 Å) P-O bond lengths. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are five inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two Al, and one H atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, one Mn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Al and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Ca, one Mn, and one P atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Ca, and one Al atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₂CaAl tetrahedra. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Mn, and one Al atom.
